# 💳 AI Fraud Detection System

An end-to-end Machine Learning system that detects fraudulent credit card transactions using **XGBoost**, handling extreme class imbalance and delivering high recall on real-world data.

---

## 🚀 Overview

This project builds a **production-style fraud detection pipeline**:

* Trained on real-world highly imbalanced dataset (~0.17% fraud)
* Uses **XGBoost with class weighting**
* Outputs **fraud probability + risk classification**
* Includes a **Streamlit web app** for real-time prediction

---

## 📊 Model Performance

| Metric          | Value   |
| --------------- | ------- |
| Accuracy        | ~99.94% |
| Fraud Recall    | ~86.7%  |
| Fraud Precision | ~77.9%  |

### Confusion Matrix

```
[[56840    24]
 [   13    85]]
```

👉 The model successfully detects the majority of fraudulent transactions with minimal false positives.

---

## 🧠 Key Concepts Used

* Imbalanced Learning (`scale_pos_weight`)
* Gradient Boosting (XGBoost)
* Probability Threshold Tuning
* Feature Scaling (StandardScaler)
* Model Evaluation (Precision, Recall, F1, Confusion Matrix)

---

## 📥 Dataset

This project uses the real-world dataset:

👉 https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/boiniabhiram/credit-card-fraud-detection

⚠️ Due to size and licensing, the dataset is **not included** in this repository.

---

## ⚙️ Installation

Clone the repository:

```
git clone git@github.com:Mehul-Mukherjee/AI_Fraud_Detection.git
cd AI_Fraud_Detection
```

Install dependencies:

```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```

---

## ▶️ Run Training

Place dataset in:

```
data/creditcard.csv
```

Then run:

```
python train.py
```

---

## 💻 Run Web App

```
streamlit run app.py
```

---

## 🎯 Features

* Real-time fraud prediction
* Probability-based risk scoring
* Interactive UI (Streamlit)
* Handles extreme imbalance (0.17% fraud)
* Production-style ML pipeline

---

## ⚠️ Important Notes
